documents.title: Recommended cash offer from Epiris at 1,120p per share
documents.source_ref: Gamma Communications plc — Rule 2.7 announcement, 1 September 2026
documents.excerpt: Bradbury Bidco (Epiris) offer values Gamma's equity at about £1.015bn (EV about £1.079bn). Completion expected in H1 2027, subject to approvals — the FY2027 budget becomes the PE baseline.

documents.title: FY2025 revenue £645.8m, adjusted EBITDA £141.7m
documents.excerpt: Gross profit £348.2m (54%) and recurring revenue £572.0m. Germany gross profit up 197% to £78.4m after acquisitions; Gamma Business GP −2%, Enterprise GP flat.

documents.title: PSTN switch-off in January 2027 accelerates legacy ceases
documents.excerpt: Exchanges in stop-sell drive legacy ISDN/PSTN ceases; customers must move to IP voice. In Gamma's billing runs, ceases ran 31% above plan in Q3 and 64% migrated to Gamma cloud products (SDP model).

documents.title: Billing run: 1,840 provisioned-but-unbilled assets
documents.source_ref: September 2026 billing run — revenue assurance (SDP model)
documents.excerpt: Provisioned vs billed vs recognised reconciliation flags about £3.7M a year of revenue leakage (0.55% of revenue), mostly Horizon seats added after the original order.

documents.title: £18.6M recurring revenue at risk — 7 partners hold 41%
documents.excerpt: Northern Comms MSP, Highfield Partner Network and Wessex Voice & Data lead the list; drivers are legacy lines with no migration order, Teams Operator Connect evaluation and billing disputes.
